[{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"Encoder-Decoder Transformers (T5, BART)"},{"order":2,"type":"paragraph","text":"The Encoder-Decoder Transformer architecture forms the foundation of modern sequence-to-sequence models in Natural Language Processing. Unlike decoder-only models tailored for generation or encoder-only models focused on embeddings, encoder-decoder models excel at tasks requiring transformation, such as translation, summarization, and text rewriting."},{"order":3,"type":"subheading","text":"Core Architecture Overview"},{"order":4,"type":"paragraph","text":"The architecture comprises two distinct stacks: an encoder that processes the input sequence into contextualized continuous representations, and a decoder that autoregressively generates the target sequence conditioned on both the encoder's output and previously generated tokens."},{"order":5,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Encoder: Processes the full input sequence using bidirectional self-attention to capture comprehensive context."},{"order":6,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Decoder: Employs causal (masked) self-attention alongside cross-attention mechanisms to attend to the encoder representations."},{"order":7,"type":"subheading","text":"Text-to-Text Transfer Transformer (T5)"},{"order":8,"type":"paragraph","text":"T5 reframes all NLP tasks into a unified text-to-text format. Whether the task is classification, translation, or summarization, the model receives a text prompt defining the task and generates the corresponding text output."},{"order":9,"type":"code","text":"from transformers import T5Tokenizer, T5ForConditionalGeneration

tokenizer = T5Tokenizer.from_pretrained('t5-small')
model = T5ForConditionalGeneration.from_pretrained('t5-small')

input_text = 'summarize: The encoder-decoder architecture is versatile for NLP tasks.'
input_ids = tokenizer(input_text, return_tensors='pt').input_ids

outputs = model.generate(input_ids)
print(tokenizer.decode(outputs[0], skip_special_tokens=True))"},{"order":10,"type":"subheading","text":"Bidirectional and Auto-Regressive Transformers (BART)"},{"order":11,"type":"paragraph","text":"BART combines a bidirectional encoder (similar to BERT) with an autoregressive decoder (similar to GPT). It is particularly effective for text generation and comprehension tasks by corrupting text with an arbitrary noise function and learning to reconstruct the original document."},{"order":12,"type":"code","text":"from transformers import BartTokenizer, BartForConditionalGeneration

tokenizer = BartTokenizer.from_pretrained('facebook/bart-large-cnn')
model = BartForConditionalGeneration.from_pretrained('facebook/bart-large-cnn')

ARTICLE = 'BART is a sequence-to-sequence model with a bidirectional encoder and a autoregressive decoder.'
inputs = tokenizer(ARTICLE, max_length=1024, return_tensors='pt')

summary_ids = model.generate(inputs['input_ids'], num_beams=4, max_length=60, early_stopping=True)
print(tokenizer.decode(summary_ids[0], skip_special_tokens=True))"},{"order":13,"type":"subheading","text":"Best Practices for Implementation"},{"order":14,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Use explicit task prefixes for T5 models to ensure the model understands the desired downstream task."},{"order":15,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Tune generation parameters like num_beams and length_penalty carefully during inference to balance quality and latency."},{"order":16,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Ensure proper attention masking for padded sequences in both encoder inputs and decoder labels."}]
